notes.title: Update: bugfix, rolls, photo mode
notes.content:
Dear friends!

It happened a little later than we planned, but we are happy to present you with a seasonal update.

The new version of the game will bring you:

[list]
[*] - Photo mode for spectacular shots to the delight of your knight friends (look for it in the menu)
[*] - Stickers, also to the delight of your knight friends
[*] - Portrait frames
[*] - Updated inputs on the controller and keyboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147222/6e01b00af4d4365572c6c5d876e109d208d31d6d.gif[/img]

[*] - Changed the running mechanics - at numerous requests from players, we added acceleration by holding down the Shift key, and not by pressing it once.
[*] - Bugfixes with controls and more! (We've been researching your reports) In particular:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] New sprint sounds
[*] Fixed model skew
[*] Player collider boxes adjusted
[*] Added butterflies to the first level!
[/olist]

We'll try to come up with something else for your amusement.
Thank you for playing our game!

notes.title: Gnomes and Knights is out now!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

Two months of development - and the game is available to the attention of the most respectable public.
At the last moment, we added immersion to the medieval experience.
Now you can not only catch gnomes and talk to various evil spirits, but also
- Fart
- Pee
- Drown in a poisonous swamp
- Die in a lot of different ways.

We hope that this will make the experience unforgettable.

Please do not judge harshly, because this is just a game based on a summer meme.
Simple entertainment. Innocent fun. Idle merry-making.

Finally, have a good game!

Sincerely yours,
Terletski Games

notes.title: "Gnomes and Knights" is coming out this Thursday!
notes.content:
Dear all, we are happy to announce that the game "Gnomes and Knights" will be released this Thursday, October 3, 2024 at 01:00 PST

[previewyoutube=x-g5hyinGDg;full][/previewyoutube]

First, catch the gameplay trailer, it will honestly show what to expect from the game.

What you can do in the game:
- Search for gnomes
- Catch gnomes
- Get gnomed
- Walk through the forest, swamp, cemetery, castle and more
- Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of dark fantasy
- Meet 9 different characters and learn the history of this cursed world

What the game will not have
- Open world
- Leveling system
- Like TES
- You will not be able to rob COROVANS 

There are 3 different paths and 6 different endings in the game.

The release is coming soon, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3107880/Gnomes_and_Knights/]add to wishlist![/url]
